scope: Coarse manual review of three images per source, plus all-row structural checks; not a full semantic audit.
all_row_checks: At least two unique choices, valid gold index, exactly one native verifier acceptance
No answer wrappers or JSON demonstration prompts in inputs/options
No identical encoded images across exported train/validation
Prepared publication checks source identity and Parquet hashes

Following the displayed five Turing-machine steps yields seven ones, agrees with gold.
